phase: Wire 直接问小事哥 (ai-chat) to the same grounded context authority: carry the scenario key (ask / quick-scenario) into the coaching call so answers speak to the user's real 6Q/profile/challenge/report evidence.
scope: pages/ai-chat/ai-chat.js (scenario passthrough). Client-only; no cloudfunction change.

architecture.deployedAiEntryPoint: generateAiReport (type=coaching) — SAME path for the six home chips and 直接问小事哥
architecture.contextAuthority: lib/context/userContextBuilder.js (UCB) — L0 6Q > L1 profile > L2 challenge > L3 report > L4 memory [gated] > L5 message
architecture.evidencePolicy: SIX_Q/PROFILE/CHALLENGE/REPORT/MEMORY/CURRENT_USER_MESSAGE only; MODEL_GUESS forbidden; missing → conditional advice + one ask
architecture.sixQAuthority: latest ai_reports{openid, reportType:turnaround_6q} orderBy createdAt desc limit 1

implementation.MEMORY_READ_GATE: generateAiReport checks memoryEngine.isMemoryEnabled BEFORE the grounded turn; L4 empty when false
implementation.SIX_Q_INDEPENDENT_OF_MEMORY: YES (memoryEnabled gates ONLY L4; 6Q/profile always applied)

rollbackPlan: git revert <commit> + redeploy prior generateAiReport. No schema/payment impact.
